title: Persian Conditional Sentences (اگر)
summary: Forming real conditional sentences in Persian.
explanation: Conjunction 'اگر' (If) + Subjunctive mood in condition + Present/Future in result.

example_translations.ex_cond_1: If I have time, I will go home.

common_error_explanations.err_cond_1: Use subjunctive verb in the 'if' clause.
